edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned directly as owner in the constructor, granting full privileged control to the deployer.
msg.sender is used to key preMints and preMintCounts and to authorize the payment pull in buyWithPaymentOnly.
claim is guarded by isOwner which compares msg.sender to owner before burning an NFT.
addPreMint is guarded by isOwner which requires msg.sender to equal owner.
deletePreMint is guarded by isOwner which requires msg.sender to equal owner.
buyWithPaymentOnly performs an external ERC20 transferFrom before its preMint state is cleared.
buyWithPaymentOnly mints the NFT through the external ERC721 contract after payment.
buyWithPaymentOnly deletes the preMint entry only after external calls complete.
buyWithPaymentOnly decrements preMintCounts using SafeMath.sub.
claim invokes an external burn on the ERC721 contract at nftAddress.
mint proxies to the external ERC721 mint function.
transferNftOwnership calls the external NFT contract transferOwnership.
changeName calls the external NFT contract changeName.
updateTokenUri calls the external NFT contract updateTokenUri.
addPreMint increments preMintCounts using SafeMath.add.
addPreMint performs an external tokenPayload call inside try/catch to detect existing NFTs.
_duplicate reads the payload string from the preMints mapping.
addPreMint writes a new PreMint struct into the preMints mapping.
buyWithPaymentOnly reads and later deletes its preMints entry.
Constructor computes price as _price * 10 ** decimals without overflow protection.
changePrice recomputes price with an unchecked multiplication by 10 ** decimals.
Constructor writes the payment token address into paymentAddress.
Constructor writes the NFT address into nftAddress.
Constructor writes the recipient address into recipientAddress.
Constructor writes the computed price into price.
Constructor initializes metadataBaseUri with a hardcoded http endpoint.
changePayment lets the owner replace paymentAddress, affecting all payment flows.
changeNft lets the owner point nftAddress at an arbitrary contract.
changeCoupon lets the owner set couponAddress.
changeRecipient lets the owner redirect the payment recipient.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable under isOwner.
changeMetadataBaseUri overwrites metadataBaseUri under isOwner.
buyWithPaymentOnly reads price to determine the payment amount.
buyWithPaymentOnly instantiates the payment token from paymentAddress.
buyWithPaymentOnly instantiates the NFT contract from nftAddress.
buyWithPaymentOnly updates the caller preMintCounts entry.
deletePreMint decrements preMintCounts before deleting the preMint.
deletePreMint removes the preMints entry for the target address and token id.
deletePreMint applies SafeMath.sub to preMintCounts.
The external transferFrom call can hand control back to the attacker and re-enter buyWithPaymentOnly before state cleanup.
The external NFT mint callback can re-enter buyWithPaymentOnly while the preMint is still set.
getOwner returns the owner state variable.
getPreMint reads the preMints mapping.
getPreMintCount reads the preMintCounts mapping.
getPaymentDecimals queries the payment token at paymentAddress.
Parameter _to is forwarded as the recipient of the external NFT mint.
Parameter _tokenId is forwarded as the token id of the external NFT mint.
Parameter image is hashed and compared against the stored preImage in buyWithPaymentOnly.
Parameter _for is the key used when incrementing preMintCounts.
Parameter _payload is stored inside the preMints struct.
Parameter preImage is stored inside the preMints struct.
Parameter newOwner becomes the new owner address in transferOwnership.
Parameter _price feeds the unchecked price multiplication in changePrice.
Parameter token is assigned to nftAddress allowing arbitrary NFT contract swap.
Local preMint struct is loaded from the preMints mapping for validation.
Local _uri is passed as the metadata uri to the external NFT mint.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only consumed by the external NFT mint call in buyWithPaymentOnly and should collapse into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _tokenId is only consumed by the external NFT mint call in buyWithPaymentOnly.
Parameter image is only used to derive the required sha256 check inside buyWithPaymentOnly.
Parameter _for is the key used for the preMintCounts SafeMath increment.
Parameter newOwner directly overwrites the owner through transferOwnership.
Parameter _price directly feeds the unchecked price multiplication in changePrice.
Local _uri is constructed solely to be passed to the external NFT mint call.
